messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 3659876543: p99 streaming latency > 5s (SLO 1.5s) detected in us-west-2. Paging @Jamie (oncall). Dashboard: https://ops.redwood/3659876543
Jamie (oncall): Acked. I'm oncall. What's the scope? Give me p95/p99 numbers and affected routes/models.
infra-bot: Metrics snapshot: route=/v1/stream generate, model=redwood-3b-v1, p95=850ms, p99=5.8s, error_rate=0.6%. Streaming stalls flagged at tail tokens.
Nina (sre): I'm in. Correlating spikes to gpu-host gpu-usw2-27. Telemetry shows rising ECC correctable counts + thermal warnings. Starting triage.
Devon (infra): Checking host telemetry now. Fan RPM shows rapid drop-and-recover 10x in last 7m — could be driver/hw hiccup. Opening console.
Maria (runtime): Streaming backlog shows KV cache miss rate up ~30% during spikes; tail tokens re-evaluating on warmup. Also saw sudden concurrency burst that bumped batch sizes.
Jamie (oncall): Customer impact? Any tenants hit hard?
Leo (cust-ops): Two enterprise tenants reported: ACME Corp and NimbusAI. ACME reports token stream stalls in voice transcripts. Rough estimate ~3% of requests slowed >2s.
Nina (sre): Quick mitigation suggestion: drain and cordon the problematic node and route traffic to the us-west-2-b pool. Need to keep regional capacity >90%.
Devon (infra): I can mark node draining and shift live traffic. Commands I'll run:
```bash
kubectl label node gpu-usw2-27 redwood/drain=manual
kubectl drain gpu-usw2-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force\```
Jamie (oncall): Do it. Also enable fallback to cpu-quantized model for streaming tails for ~30m while stabilizing. Maria, can you flip fallback and lower batch sizes?
Maria (runtime): On it. Pushing runtime flag to prefer redwood-3b-v1-quant for streaming routes under token-latency pressure and reducing max_batch_size 64->32. Config push:
```json
{"route":"/v1/stream","fallback":"redwood-3b-v1-quant","batch_limit":32}
```
infra-bot: Node gpu-usw2-27 marked unschedulable. Drain progress: 40%.
Devon (infra): Host console excerpt (18:10 UTC):
```
[2026-03-15T18:10:12Z] ECC_CORRECTABLE +12
[2026-03-15T18:10:14Z] GPU_THERMAL_WARN: temp spike -> 94C
[2026-03-15T18:10:18Z] FAN_RPM: 3400 -> 1200 -> 3500
[2026-03-15T18:10:22Z] THROTTLE: frequency scaled down
```
Nina (sre): That pattern looks like intermittent fan spin-down causing thermal throttling and ECC noise. Explains tail stalls: KV cache eviction + kernel reschedule during throttle windows.
Jamie (oncall): Immediate plan: keep node drained, reboot hardware to clear thermal state, open vendor ticket for fan assembly. Tag sev=high.
Devon (infra): Rebooting host now: `ipmi -H bmc-usw2-27 -u root -p **** chassis power cycle`. ETA ~3m to come back. After boot, run stress + ECC monitor for 20m before uncordon.
Maria (runtime): Config flips live. Routing shows ~95% of streams now using fallback path. Region p99 down to 1.9s, p95 620ms. Still above SLO but trending down.
Leo (cust-ops): :thumbsup: I'll post a customer note to ACME & NimbusAI: short status, mitigation in place, ETA for next update 15m.
Jamie (oncall): Owners: Nina (primary SRE), Devon (hardware/infra), Maria (runtime). I'll handle customer comms and postmortem. We escalate to P1 if impact >5% of requests.
infra-bot: Host power cycle complete. Node telemetry attached: temp stabilized ~72C, ECC correctable back to baseline. Starting stresscheck.
Devon (infra): Stress test results:
```
gpu_stress --time 600 --threads 8
Result: no ECC increments after reboot
Thermal: stable 70-76C
Bandwidth: nominal
```
Nina (sre): Good. Keep node cordoned for 30m for observation. If stable, we'll uncordon with gradual canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
Maria (runtime): Canary policy pushed: 5% traffic for 2m then 25% for 5m. Rolling batch_limit back on successful canary.
Jamie (oncall): Customer update posted. Next update in 20m or earlier on regression. Postmortem timeline: initial notes by EOD, full RCA in 3 business days. Thanks everyone.
Leo (cust-ops): :eyes: ACME wants SLA impact details; I'll coordinate follow-up.
Nina (sre): Action items added to incident tracker: vendor ticket for fan, node postmortem, review autoscaling/automatic batch scaling under thermal events.
Jamie (oncall): :thumbsup: Closing live mitigation phase in 30m; keep thread open for follow-ups and RCA drafts.
